mainEntity.name: How can AEO help improve local search rankings for each of my business's locations?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO directly impacts local search rankings by ensuring that AI search engines and voice assistants have accurate, consistent, and comprehensive information about each of your business locations. By optimizing Google Business Profiles, local citations, and website content with location-specific keywords and structured data, AEO signals to search algorithms that your business is a relevant and authoritative answer for 'near me' queries. This increased accuracy and relevance can lead to higher placement in local search results, map packs, and direct answers provided by voice assistants, driving more qualified leads to each physical storefront.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO improves local rankings by providing accurate, consistent, location-specific data to AI search engines, making your business more relevant for 'near me' queries and boosting visibility in local results.
